responsibility: This definition module defines the language-level Modula-2 exception enumeration used by the gm2 runtime and exposes queries for the current exception state. It belongs to the exception subsystem and provides the stable mapping of language exception kinds such as index, range, division, invalid location, and coroutine errors, together with M2Exception and IsM2Exception for inspecting the active exception block.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition half of the M2EXCEPTION pair: it fixes the public M2Exceptions enumeration and declares the query procedures. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/M2EXCEPTION.mod, it does not touch RTExceptions state or implement the queries.
